description: Complete payment using Stripe ACP (Shared Payment Token). Only use this if your platform supports Stripe Agentic Commerce Protocol and can provision an SPT. If your platform does NOT support ACP, use the `payment_url` from checkout_create instead, then poll checkout_status. Requires authentication.

shared_payment_token.title: Shared Payment Token
